cords.name: p2
cords.notes: At 25.0 cm, a separate cord is doubled and tied to end of pendant

cords.name: p2s1
cords.notes: Attachment label "t" indicates a subsidary attached by twisting the sub. cord around pendant (or a sub) and then plying

cords.name: p13s1
cords.notes: Cord of sub 13s1 goes around pendant and then through the axis of the long knot

cords.name: p14s1
cords.notes: 14s1 is attached by a complex knot around pendant; end of knot is cut off

cords.name: p30s1
cords.notes: Sub 30s1 is attached inside the single knot

cords.name: p80s1
cords.notes: Sub 80s1 passed through the axis of the single knot and knotted to secure it in place

cords.name: p82s1
cords.notes: sub 82s1 is knotted around pendant in same manner as pendants are knotted around primary cord (see observations, note 1)

cords.name: p85s1
cords.notes: Sub 85s1 passes through pendant ply and is then knotted around pendant

cords.name: p102s1
cords.notes: Sub 102s1 is attached by half-hitch knot with 3.5 cm of cord protruding (in addition to sub)

cords.name: p108
cords.notes: Pendant cord is spliced and knotted at 11.5 cm.
